subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the first frame of [Shot 1], showing <Subject 1> standing on a smoky ancient battlefield with both arms extended sideways, each hand holding a curved crescent scimitar, dark red gauze battle skirt and long dark hair pushed by hot wind, embers drifting past, ruined siege towers and tattered banners in the background.
<Picture 2> is the character-design reference sheet for <Subject 1>, showing front, side, and back views plus a close-up of the head: a young East Asian woman with long dark hair swept up under an elaborate bronze-gold filigree crown with dangling bead chains, off-shoulder dark red bodice with embossed bronze-gold chest armor, matching bronze-gold segmented arm greaves, layered dark red gauze skirt with asymmetric torn hems, and dark leather boots.
<Subject 1> is the female war goddess in <Picture 1> and <Picture 2>, armed with two ornate bronze-gold crescent scimitars, wearing dark red and bronze-gold fantasy Chinese armor, a filigree crown, and long dark hair.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video is a 10-second action blockbuster opening from <Picture 1> and continuing the battle. <Subject 1> fights through enemy ranks on the burning battlefield using twin crescent scimitars, executing a chained assault of parries, spinning cuts, aerial rotation, and a final slow-motion ground-shattering cross-cut. <Picture 1> supplies the first-frame composition and pose; <Picture 2> supplies the full costume, hairstyle, crown, and weapon details for consistent character retention.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - the low-angle battlefield stance, twin extended crescent scimitars, dark red and bronze-gold armor, wind-driven hair and skirt, drifting embers, ruined siege towers, and tattered banners are retained as the opening frame.
<Picture 2> (costume reference for all shots): fully_preserved - the off-shoulder dark red bodice, embossed bronze-gold chest armor, segmented arm greaves, layered dark red gauze skirt, filigree crown with bead chains, long dark hair, and twin ornate scimitars are retained throughout.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1] through [Shot 8]): fully_preserved - facial features, body type, armor, weapons, hair, and crown remain consistent; only pose, camera angle, and dynamic states change.

detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic fantasy action sequence with a desaturated, ash-heavy color palette, high-contrast firelight, and fast-paced camera work grounded in physical martial movement.
[Shot 1] The video begins from <Picture 1>. A wide low-angle shot frames <Subject 1> at center, both crescent scimitars extended horizontally to the sides, elbows slightly bent, dark red gauze skirt and long hair pushed sideways by hot battlefield wind. Embers drift across the foreground; behind her, ruined wooden siege towers burn and torn banners flap on tilted poles beneath a heavy overcast sky. Her gaze locks off-screen right. The camera begins a slow counter-clockwise orbit around her left shoulder, tightening from a wide to a medium shot.
[Shot 2] At 00:01.000, the camera drops to a low-angle close-up of <Subject 1>'s right boot stamping into the scorched earth. A radial ring of dust and small stones erupts outward from the impact. She launches forward, twin blades crossing in front of her chest, speed lines and displaced embers trailing behind her silhouette as the camera tracks her movement from a low side angle.
[Shot 3] At 00:01.800, a medium-close flank-tracking shot shows <Subject 1> rushing into the enemy line. Her left scimitar sweeps horizontally to meet an incoming spear shaft, knocking it upward; her right scimitar follows in a continuous upward crescent arc, steel sparks spraying from the clash. The enemy weapon spins out of frame and the spear-wielder recoils backward.
[Shot 4] At 00:02.800, <Subject 1> uses the upward momentum to spin counter-clockwise, her layered dark red skirt fanning into a wide torn circle around her legs. Both blades cross downward in an X-shaped cut toward the ground. The blade edges kick up a pressure wave that splits the earth into two radiating cracks,碎石 and dust bursting upward around her boots.
[Shot 5] At 00:04.000, the camera reverses to a medium shot from the enemy's side. A blade sweeps in from frame right; <Subject 1> drops into a low crouch, hair and crown bead chains streaming left from the wind of the missed strike. Her left scimitar rises to block the incoming blade near the guard, metal ringing, while her right scimitar stabs forward past the block toward the enemy's torso.
[Shot 6] At 00:05.200, <Subject 1> pushes off the blocked blade and springs upward, her body arching backward, both scimitars drawing twin silver crescents behind her shoulders. She rotates 540 degrees in mid-air, skirt and long hair spreading radially around her, embers and ash swirling in the vortex of her spin. The camera follows her rotation from below.
[Shot 7] At 00:07.000, an overhead tracking shot falls with <Subject 1> as she descends. She brings both scimitars together above her head and crosses them downward for the final strike. The action briefly enters a 0.6-second slow-motion蓄力 phase: her arms extend, blade edges glow with condensed air pressure, and the surrounding dust particles hang suspended. Then contact occurs and speed resumes instantly; the ground shatters in a spiderweb pattern, rock fragments trailing outward in slow arcs, and a two-frame white flash washes across the screen.
[Shot 8] At 00:08.800, the camera yanks back from the impact center to a wide shot. <Subject 1> lands on one knee, left knee pressed into the cracked earth, right foot planted, both scimitars held low at her sides. Her dark red gauze skirt pools around her on the ground and the crown's dangling bead chains sway. Behind her, the battlefield continues to burn and tattered banners flap. She slowly raises her head, gaze still locked forward, as drifting embers pass through the frame.

overall_soundscape:
The burning battlefield ambience persists throughout: distant fire crackle, hot wind gusting through ruins, and tattered banners flapping. Physical sounds include the radial dust burst of the stamping boot, steel-on-steel clangs and grinding sparks during blade parries, the slicing whoosh of scimitars cutting air, the low thud of the crossed blades hitting earth, spiderweb ground cracking,碎石 trailing outward, and a final settling of dust and debris.

non_diegetic_music:
An intense orchestral action score drives the sequence: urgent tremolo strings from the opening, low brass stabs entering at 00:01.500, pounding percussion and timpani building through the spinning aerial phase, and a full orchestral swell peaking at the final slow-motion impact before dropping to a low sustained drone and a single deep drum hit as <Subject 1> lands.
